result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers say plainly that the setup is sound and that nothing blocks shipping. A has a small factual error: on Windows the stack would reach Sitka Text before Cambria. A also floats bundling a web font, which comes close to suggesting new families, though only conditionally. B gives the more useful practical fixes (right-aligning the numeric columns, matching sans and serif sizes) and correctly lists Sitka. However, B adds some padding: the monospace and naming items, and it overstates how much tabular-nums depends on right-alignment. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers say the setup is sound and avoid lists of trendy fonts. A gives a concrete reason it works (system stacks with no web-font load flash) and keeps its suggestions small, with the right-alignment fix as the main practical one. B suggests bundling a web-font sans and makes that its key point, which edges toward replacing the families. Its faux-bold point is also mostly padding.
